description: This file provides API client functions for a React frontend, including environment-based URL configuration, mock mode handling, and wrapper functions for fetch requests and file uploads.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables, ensuring no trailing slash.

methods.name: apiFetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with JSON handling, routing to mock functions if mock mode is enabled.

methods.name: apiUploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file to the server or returns a mock URL if in mock mode.
